summarize.title: Inception
summarize.text: A skilled thief named Cobb steals secrets by entering people's dreams. Offered a chance to return home to his children, he agrees to do the opposite: plant an idea in a businessman's mind. He assembles a team, and together they descend through several nested dream levels, each with its own rules and passage of time. Cobb's guilt over his late wife keeps invading the dreams and endangers the mission. In the end he completes the job, and a spinning top leaves the audience unsure if he has returned to reality.
summarize.reference: A dream thief leads a team into nested dreams to plant an idea in a target's mind, hoping to earn his way home to his children.

summarize.title: Titanic
summarize.text: In 1912 a poor young artist, Jack, wins a ticket aboard the luxury liner Titanic and falls in love with Rose, a wealthy passenger engaged to a man she does not love. Their romance blossoms over a few days across the class divide. Then the ship strikes an iceberg and begins to sink, and the lovers fight to survive amid chaos as there are not enough lifeboats. Jack saves Rose but dies in the freezing water. Rose lives on and recalls the story decades later.
summarize.reference: A poor artist and a wealthy young woman fall in love aboard the Titanic, and he dies saving her when the ship sinks.

summarize.title: The Lion King
summarize.text: Simba is a young lion prince who is expected to rule the African savanna after his father, King Mufasa. His jealous uncle Scar kills Mufasa and convinces Simba that it was his fault, so Simba runs away. He grows up carefree in the jungle with the friends Timon and Pumbaa. Years later his childhood friend Nala finds him and urges him to return. Simba finds the courage to face Scar, takes back the throne and restores the kingdom.
summarize.reference: A lion prince exiled after his father's murder grows up, returns and defeats his usurping uncle to reclaim the throne.

summarize.title: 3 Idiots
summarize.text: Two friends, Farhan and Raju, search for their old college friend Rancho, who made them reconsider the pressure of engineering college. At the elite institute Rancho had cheerfully challenged rote learning, saying that curiosity matters more than marks and ranks, and often clashed with the strict director. Years later the friends discover the truth about his disappearance and the man he became, and the film mixes comedy with a message about education and pursuing one's passion.
summarize.reference: Two friends look for their free-thinking college pal Rancho, a story that humorously criticises rote learning and urges people to follow their passion.

summarize.title: Jurassic Park
summarize.text: A wealthy businessman opens a theme park on an island, populated with dinosaurs cloned from ancient DNA. Before opening, he invites a paleontologist, a paleobotanist and a mathematician to endorse it, and his grandchildren join the tour. When a worker sabotages the security system to steal embryos during a storm, the dinosaurs escape their enclosures. The visitors have to survive the predators and escape the island, learning that nature cannot be easily controlled.
summarize.reference: Cloned dinosaurs escape a theme park after a security failure, and the visiting experts and children must flee the island.

summarize.title: The Matrix
summarize.text: Thomas Anderson, a software programmer who works under the hacker alias Neo, is contacted by rebels who tell him that the world he knows is a simulation built by machines to keep humans docile while using their bodies as energy. Neo takes the red pill, wakes up in the real world and is trained by Morpheus. Believing he may be the prophesied One, he returns to the simulation to fight the agents who guard it, and discovers he can bend its rules.
summarize.reference: A hacker learns his world is a machine-made simulation, joins the human rebels and discovers he can bend its rules.
